newsitem.title: USA: SOCCER-RESULT OF MLS FINAL, WON BY WASHINGTON D.C. UNITED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RESULT OF MLS FINAL, WON BY WASHINGTON D.C. UNITED.

text.p: D.C. United defeated the Los Angeles Galaxy 3-2 (halftime 0-1)
in extra time in the Major League Soccer championship game at
Los Angeles - Eduardo Hurtado (fifth minute), Chris Armas
Los Angeles - Jorge Campos, Mark Semioli, Robin Fraser,
Greg Vanney, Arash Noamouz, Jorge Salcedo (Curt Onalfo 77th),
Chris Armas, Mauricio Cienfuegos, Cobi Jones, Harut Karapetyan
Washington - Mark Simpson, Clint Peay, Eddie Pope, Jeff
Agoos, Mario Gori (Shawn Medved 70th), Richie Williams, John
Maessner (Tony Sanneh 59th), John Harkes, Marco Etcheverry,
